text: Data governance in production — what it actually means, beyond a vague compliance word.

Cataloging is knowing what data exists and where — purview does for fabric what unity catalog does for databricks. Lineage traces where a value came from. Ownership is who's actually responsible for it.
Lineage traces a dashboard number back through every stage that produced it — genuinely useful when the question is which of these four stages introduced the error.

A real-time dashboard that's wrong is wrong right now, in front of whoever's watching — exactly why governance matters more here, not less. Next up: handling PII and sensitive data, governance's sharpest edge.
